sections.title: Louisiana property tax: state rules: figures under review

rows.label: Homestead exemption
rows.value: First $7,500 of assessed value (about $75,000 of market value) of an owner-occupied home
rows.note: Louisiana Constitution Art. VII, Sec. 20. A 2025 amendment (to $12,500 assessed from 2027) went to voters on Nov 3, 2026; result not verified. Snippet only.

sections.title: Louisiana real estate transfer tax: figures under review

rows.label: State real estate transfer tax
rows.value: None: the state levies no transfer tax, and the constitution bars any new transfer tax (state or local) since November 30, 2011
rows.note: Art. VII, Sec. 2.3. The ban covers new taxes only; recordation fees and ad valorem taxes are excluded. Snippet only.
